action: In general, a standard system update will make all the necessary changes.
description:
Choi Jaeseung discovered that pngquant incorrectly handled certain PNG
images, leading to a buffer overflow. An attacker could possibly use this
issue to cause pngquant to crash or execute arbitrary code.
isummary:
pngquant could be made to crash or run programs as your login if it opened
a specially crafted file.

pngquant.description: PNG (Portable Network Graphics) image optimising utility

title: pngquant vulnerability
